title: Potato Booster
description: the minimum you need to boost your potato
body:
A lightweight performance-focused Minecraft modpack built for low-end PCs, laptops, and “why is my FPS 12” situations.

This pack is designed to squeeze out as much performance as possible using essential optimization mods, keeping gameplay smooth, stable, and minimal.

Unlike most performance modpacks, this one stays strictly focused on performance — not clutter.

 What’s included:
Core performance optimization mods
FPS improvement and rendering tweaks
Memory and chunk-loading optimizations
Stability fixes for smoother gameplay
What’s NOT included (on purpose):
No unnecessary QoL mods like capes, minimaps, or cosmetic extras
No bloated feature packs pretending to be “performance mods”
No pre-installed extras you didn’t ask for
 Philosophy:

Keep it clean. Keep it fast. Let users decide their own QoL mods instead of forcing them into a bundle they didn’t want.

 Best for:
Low-end PCs / laptops
Vanilla+ performance setups
Players who want FPS, not fluff
